channel.title: TimTime
channel.description: Updates for TimTime — a minimalist macOS menu bar time tracker.

item.title: Version 1.0.3
item.description:
TimTime 1.0.3

  • Fixed a crash that could quit the app unexpectedly during check-in prompts.
  • Stand-up reminders now repeat every 15 minutes once you're overdue for a break, instead of nudging just once.
  • The break prompt is now part of the same check-in — one interface, with a big "time since last break" and varied encouragement to step away.
  • New: a "Take a break" button pinned at the bottom of the menu, always in the same place.

item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
TimTime 1.0.2

  • Fixed: no longer quietly switches itself to a break when a check-in goes unanswered.
  • A break that started on its own (e.g. after your Mac sleeps) now ends and asks what you're working on as soon as you're back at the keyboard.

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
TimTime 1.0.1

  • New: About TimTime panel and a "Last checked" update line.
  • Refined break prompt — one tap to take a break or keep your current task.
  • Fixes the in-app update check (feed URL).

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
TimTime 1.0.0

  • First public release — minimalist menu bar time tracking.
  • Switch-to-start labels, daily/weekly breakdown, gentle work/break nudges.
